## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Controls for passenger hoists are to be inside the cage and for goods hoists outside the cage. Hoist operators are to be trained and be certified for the type of hoist in use.
- All loads on theplatform mustbesecured and there should benoprojections.
- Hoists that are designated for the carriage of goods only must not be used for carrying passengers.
- Inhighwinds hoists are tobeused in accordancewithmanufacturer's recommendations.Where winds arc in excess of recommended limits thehoist platform is tobe lowered to theground and the main supply isolated.

## 3.18. Steelwork

- >A competent designer must design the erection sequence of steelwork so that at all times the structure remains stablefrom when thefirst piece of steelworkis putintoposition until it is completed.
- Temporary supports such as bracing, guys or stays must be used during the erection of any structure whichmaybeunstableor liableto collapsebeforeit is completed.
- Additionally where any work is carried out which is likely to adversely affect the foundations or stability of any existing building or structure all practicable precautions such as shoring, must be taken.
- Assembly of steelwork components ormaking connections should beplanned so that steelworkers can do as much of the work as possible at ground level. Where steelworkers have to work at height, provision must be made for safe access to the connecting points and any other working places.
- Wherever possible, steelwork should be marked as an aid to identification and assisting the steel erectors where components fit
- Potentially hazardous site features such as overhead electric cables must be taking into consideration when planning the work.
- Erection of steelwork is only to be carried out by trained and experienced personnel.
- Whcrc stcclwork isbcing crcctcd the areas directlybeneath and the inmediatevicinity is to befiee of personnel to prevent personnel being struck by any falling materials or objects.
- Platforms, gangways, floors and other places must not be obstructed by loose materials and materials must be stacked safely.
- The delivery, storage and erection of steelwork must be properly planned with a suitable and sufficient risk assessment and agreed methodstatementforthe activities.

## 3.19.PlantandVehicles

- All plant andvehicles used onsitewill besuitablefor theworksbeing undertaken andbe preferably less than 5 years old. Contractors shall make arrangements to ensure that all mobile plant and vehicles are checked on entering the site to ensure they are in good working order.
- Plant andvehicles shall beinspected daily and thereafter in accordance with current legislation.Plant and vehicles that are found to be defective will be removed from service and sent for repair.
- Maintenance of plant and vehicles is to be carried out in accordance with manufacturer's instructions.
